A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GaussianSpa and contain 16 readable pages, including the four-page appendix. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary results support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original GaussianSpa benchmark results, rendering comparisons, sensitivity analyses, and storage measurements, including per-scene results in appendix Tables 3–5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results and analyses in the main text and appendix, including GaussianSpa's quantitative scores and visual outputs.

M1.justification: The constrained-opacity formulation, alternating optimization and projection steps, multiplier updates, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Figure 3's corrected gradient already appears correctly in v1's Eqs. 13–14.

E1.justification: Both evaluate novel-view synthesis on the same 13 scenes across Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks&Temples, and Deep Blending. Main-text and appendix dataset and scenario coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains 3DGS, CompactGaussian, LP-3DGS-R/M, EAGLES, Mini-Splatting, Taming 3DGS, and CompGS. LightGaussian remains in visual and curve comparisons; Table 2 retains EfficientGS and LightGaussian. Appendix comparator membership also matches.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same metrics, Mini-Splatting checkpoint initialization, optimization/sparsification starting at iteration 15K, and Gaussian removal at 25K. No evaluation settings or procedures change in the appendix.

E4.justification: The Gaussian-count/reduction-rate sweeps, penalty and interval convergence analyses, compression studies, and visual case studies remain unchanged. Figure 5's revised insets redisplay existing cases without adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates and scene averages without run-count or seed disclosures, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests. Their statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5, quantitative curves, and reported findings remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 27.85 dB PSNR with 0.547M Gaussians on Mip-NeRF 360. Figure 5 refreshes detail insets while retaining the same full-scene outputs and qualitative conclusions.

T1.justification: Figure 3 corrects the Θ-update derivative from ∂L(a,Θ)/∂a to ∂L(a,Θ)/∂Θ. This localized mathematical correction aligns the diagram with the already-correct Eqs. 13–14; the derivations, assumptions, and convergence statements otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same optimization-based simplification contributions and rendering-quality claims, including the approximately 0.9 dB improvement with 10× fewer Gaussians on Deep Blending.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning information preservation, adaptive Gaussian density, convergence, generality, and compatibility with compression remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the project-page address from gaussianspa.github.io to noodle-lab.github.io/gaussianspa. Implementation and hardware disclosures remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in the resources available at those addresses.

R1.justification: The same 55 references and related-work discussions are retained, including positioning against heuristic pruning and connections to sparse optimization. No cited work or substantive novelty positioning changes.

P1.justification: Text edits are limited to the project address and arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is reformatted more compactly and its gradient label corrected. Figure 5 replaces its detail insets with higher-resolution, revised crops. There is local text reflow, while table displays and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 removes the incorrect gradient variable in Figure 3 and provides clearer detail insets in Figure 5, modestly improving consistency and visual inspection. The method, experimental evidence, claims, and appendix results remain unchanged, so the overall benefit is limited.
